SiteProfile.title: SiteProfile
SiteProfile.description: Public portfolio profile photo configuration managed by the admin.

photoUrl.description: Public download URL of the profile photo stored in Firebase Storage.

photoStoragePath.description: Storage object path for the uploaded profile image.

altText.description: Accessible Arabic/English alt text for the profile portrait.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who last updated the profile photo.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A software or IT engineering project showcased on the portfolio.

title.description: Project title (kept in English per design requirements).

category.description: Project category such as Web, Mobile, or Desktop System.

techStack.description: Key technologies used, formatted as a concise string.

imageUrl.description: Optional cover image path or URL.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created the project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated.

email.description: Verified Google account email of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

/siteSettings/{settingId}.description: Public portfolio visual settings (profile portrait URL and alt text).

/projects/{projectId}.description: Portfolio projects displayed on the main page and managed in /admin.
